Reliable road transport — Poland & EU

We are a family‑run carrier from Łódź with 6+ years of hands‑on experience. We operate 3.5 t vans and trucks, providing 24/7 domestic and international transport. Every shipment has a dedicated dispatcher and real‑time GPS tracking.

Why work with us

  • Express door‑to‑door across Poland & the EU,
  • Van & TIR fleet, GPS and cargo insurance,
  • One point of contact and clear communication,
  • Family business values: loyalty, stability, punctuality,
  • Fair pricing with no hidden fees.

What we carry

Full‑load and time‑critical cargo: EURO pallets, parcels, exhibition materials, retail fixtures, metal parts, furniture, electronics, automotive components.

Coverage & lead times

Poland and Schengen countries. Typical transit for EU lanes: 24–48 h for 1200–2000 km with 3.5 t vans. Constant GPS updates.

Process

1) 15‑minute quote, 2) route plan & vehicle selection, 3) confirmation, 4) live tracking during the run, 5) proof of delivery and documents (CMR).

Industries

E‑commerce (incl. warehouse transfers), automotive, manufacturing, events & trade fairs, retail. Experience serving major logistics programs (e.g., InPost, Arvato via partners) with express FTL vans.

Pricing

Transparent, all‑inclusive quotes. Volume discounts for regular runs. Contact us 24/7.
